snippet.title: Mosaic of the Strange - #nextfest teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Big news – the Mosaic of the Strange demo is live right now as part of Steam Next Fest!
You can jump in today and start uncovering a brand new mosaic packed with strange happenings, cryptids, and mysterious case files.

This is the most ambitious game yet in the Mosaic series:

Over 100,000 tiles (that’s nearly double Proverbs!)
Six interconnected locations to explore – including the ‘Agents’ Field Office’ and a suspicious crime scene
New optional Advanced Deduction mechanics for hardcore puzzlers
Five difficulty levels that you can switch between anytime
And… characters talk now - Mosaic of the Strange includes text-based dialogue!


You’ll get to help FBI Special Agents Cullen and Brady as they investigate a bizarre murder, building their cases by researching 125 real-world paranormal files. 

All progress from the demo carries over to the full game, so feel free to take your time exploring every corner.

🎮 Play the demo here:
http://bit.ly/MotS_Demo

🗓️ Full release coming 7 November 2025!
